definitions.explanation: A wood made up of pine trees, often seen along the coast where pines are planted as windbreaks.

examples.japanese: {海岸|かいがん}に{松林|まつばやし}が{続|つづ}く。
examples.english: A pine grove stretches along the coast.

examples.japanese: {松林|まつばやし}の{中|なか}を{散歩|さんぽ}した。
examples.english: I took a walk through the pine woods.

examples.japanese: この{松林|まつばやし}は{潮風|しおかぜ}から{畑|はたけ}を{守|まも}るために{植|う}えられた。
examples.english: This pine grove was planted to protect the fields from the sea breeze.

notes:
Formed from {松|まつ} (pine) + {林|はやし} (woods), with rendaku making it まつばやし. White-sand beaches lined with green pine groves ({白砂青松|はくしゃせいしょう}) are a classic image of the Japanese coast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {松林|まつばやし}が{続|つづ}く: a pine grove stretches on
- {海岸|かいがん}の{松林|まつばやし}: a coastal pine grove
- {松林|まつばやし}を{抜|ぬ}ける: pass through the pine woods
